packages.title: Generate and synchronize nested evidence work packages
packages.description: Generate the deterministic three-level work graph.
acceptance_criteria: The manifest contains track, phase and work-package hierarchy.

packages.title: Synchronize the authoritative graph to GitHub
packages.description: Apply the generated graph idempotently.
packages.blocker: Requires authenticated GitHub and Projects access.

packages.title: Enforce controlled blinding and authorized unblinding
packages.description: Keep model identities restricted until verified freezes authorize unblinding.

packages.title: Qualify deterministic mock visual judges and failure modes
packages.description: Exercise judge identities and failures deterministically.

packages.title: Collect empirical human and automatic-judge calibration evidence
packages.description: Collect governed participant calibration evidence.
packages.blocker: Requires participant recruitment and governance approval.

packages.title: Persist a crash-safe ownership-aware campaign ledger
packages.description: Persist atomic leases and content-addressed terminal transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Lease ownership and expiry are enforced.

packages.title: Exercise provider contracts with deterministic mocks
packages.description: Test provider requests and bounded failures through local mocks.

packages.title: Execute bounded campaign cells through the benchmark runner
packages.description: Join leasing, adapters, scoring and terminal state retention.
acceptance_criteria: A worker completes an eligible cell.

packages.title: Qualify live contestant and judge endpoints
packages.description: Run frozen canaries against selected endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Each endpoint passes or is excluded.

packages.title: Exclude restricted blinding and participant artifacts from public bundles
packages.description: Apply publication allowlists and deny lists.

packages.title: Publish dataset, explorer and environment surfaces
packages.description: Publish verified Hub surfaces.

packages.title: Run the deterministic mock and autonomous quality matrix
packages.description: Run all local test-taxonomy lanes and coverage.

packages.title: Execute strict external analyzers in remote CI
packages.description: Run configured external analyzers.

packages.title: Activate Codecov and Renovate evidence
packages.description: Receive failure-closed coverage and dependency evidence.

packages.title: Verify deterministic agent and autonomous drawing behaviour
packages.description: Replay agent actions and bounded recovery deterministically.

packages.title: Validate a real structured-canvas application adapter
packages.description: Validate a supported real application trajectory.

packages.title: Red-team blinding and publication leakage
packages.description: Test unauthorized disclosure and restricted paths.

packages.title: Exercise deterministic provider and campaign fault injection
packages.description: Retain every scripted provider fault.
acceptance_criteria: The ledger remains valid after failures.

packages.title: Detect path-outlined and rasterized evaluator prompt injection
packages.description: Detect non-text-node evaluator instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Outlined and raster attacks are detected.
packages.blocker: Requires OCR or human adjudication evidence.

packages.title: Lock blinding and execution-integrity amendments before data
packages.description: Commit every normative before-data file by digest.

packages.title: Complete an all-in-one detached clean-clone verification
packages.description: Verify the exact tag in a detached clean clone.
packages.blocker: A final v0.6 clean-clone receipt is required.

packages.title: Publish and attest the operational alpha release
packages.description: Publish the verified tag and attestations.
packages.blocker: Requires GitHub and Hugging Face publication.
